messages:
paul: Heads-up: I'm trying to teach new hires how to run the eval harness from the Next starter during onboarding. The flow in the README is a bit fragmentary and people keep getting tripped up on envs and the local dedicated image.

anya: Oof same. The current README has a 2-step flow but misses that you need to build the local docker image with the right tag before running evals. New hires ran `yarn eval` then wondered why the server returned 404.

frank: Can you paste the exact commands you followed? We should make the script as copy-pasteable as possible.

paul: Sure, this is what someone ran: 

```bash
# from examples/next-starter
yarn install
# forgot: docker build -t redwood/dedicated:dev .
yarn eval --config eval/config.local.json --target http://localhost:8080
```

paul: Result was "connection refused" because docker image wasn't running. The README only shows the eval command.

anya: Suggestion: add a single script `dev-setup.sh` in the example that runs the docker build + docker run in one step and prints the env exports. People copy that into their terminal during onboarding.

frank: Agreed. Also the eval harness needs NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_API set for the client samples; if don't set it the eval logs are confusing (401s). We should surface that in the quickstart checklist.

docs-bot: Proposed PR template entry: "Examples: include dev-setup.sh + onboarding checklist with explicit env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_API, REDWOOD_API_KEY, EVAL_DATA_PATH) and required docker tag."

paul: I'll draft the script. Minimal: 

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# dev-setup.sh: builds and runs the local dedicated dev image
docker build -t redwood/dedicated:dev ../dedicated
docker run -d --rm -p 8080:8080 --name redwood-dev redwood/dedicated:dev
echo "export NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_API=http://localhost:8080"
```

anya: Nice. Also add a short troubleshooting section: how to read eval logs, common errors (401 vs 404), and a pointer to `yarn eval --dry-run` if available. New hires will thank us. :pray:

sdk-team: We should also add a CLI flag to the eval harness `--ensure-target` that fails fast with a clear message if the target doesn't respond or returns 4xx/5xx. Filing SDK issue to track: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/945

paul: Filed a docs PR draft and attached the script: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/112 - includes updated README and onboarding checklist. Can someone from docs review?

anya: I'll review and add the troubleshooting tips. Also we should add a short recorded screencast for the onboarding loop (30-60s) and link it in the README.

frank: LGTM, thanks. Once merged, add a note to the onboarding checklist so hiring managers point new folks at the updated example.

paul: Thanks everyone — this should reduce support tickets during ramp.
